summary: Woori Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution recommending a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 220 per common share, with a record date of May 11, 2026 and payment on May 29, 2026. The total dividend amounts to KRW 160.8 billion. The dividend will be funded from capital reserve converted to retained earnings and is structured to be non-taxable for most shareholders under Korean tax law, except for large shareholders. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No other transactional or structural changes are disclosed, and the filing reflects ordinary course capital return.
